notes: No duplicate-company precedent (first AmbienteDirect entry, per BRIEF's no-precedent list). Access: direct fetch worked with no WAF/block - HTTP 200 on homepage and every category page fetched; homepage auto-redirects to the /en (English) locale which already carries plain-English category names throughout the mega-nav, so no German->English translation of nav labels was needed (site's own English category names used verbatim, only lightly normalized for consistency e.g. 'Clocks & watches'->'Clocks'). robots.txt has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User specific group and no Disallow on any /categories/ path - only account/info/newsletter paths blocked. Platform is Intershop Commerce Suite (pid_/art= product URL pattern). Rule 1 counts: large categories use the site's own rendered 'NN of TOTAL products' header text under the product grid (e.g. '40 of 2270 products'); single-page categories with no Load-more trigger (fewer than ~40 items, so no header text renders) were counted by extracting unique product identifiers from the page's embedded GA4 ecommerce tracking data (data-ecommerce-item item_id, cross-checked against item_category3 to rule out cross-sell/carousel contamination) - spot-checked on Chandeliers (22 divs incl. dummies vs 22 unique tagged item_ids, exact match) and Torches & Lanterns (20/20 all tagged to the target category). RULE 0.6 duplicate found and dropped: 'Bedside lamps' (/categories/lighting/bedside-lamps, header '40 of 452 products') is an exact duplicate listing of 'Table lamps' (/categories/lighting/table-lamps, header '40 of 452 products') - the two pages' first 40 product IDs are 100% identical (40/40 overlap) despite separate canonical URLs; kept Table Lamps only, Bedside Lamps dropped as same-listing-second-URL per Rule 0.6. 'Interior lights' (2073 products) excluded as a redundant 'shop-all-indoor-lighting' roll-up: breadcrumbs show Suspension/Ceiling/Table/etc lamps as direct children of Lighting (not of Interior Lights), so Interior Lights is a sibling catch-all superset of the individually-extracted lamp types, not a structural parent - treated like a Shop-All page per NEVER EXTRACT. Excluded per bulbs/parts rule: 'Illuminants' (light bulbs) and 'Lamp accessories' (lampshades/replacement parts, sampled titles e.g. 'Trípode G5 Lampshade' - not fixtures). Mixed roll-ups dropped per 'drop, don't pad' after title inspection: 'Bath accessories' (416 products, dominated by towels/bath textiles, laundry baskets, drying racks, soap dispensers, toilet brushes/shower wipers - functional storage/textiles/plumbing; its handful of mirrors duplicate the dedicated Mirrors category); 'Living accessories' (1974 products, a cross-category facet mixing rugs/seat-mats/textiles, pet beds, storage crates, coat hooks, and items already captured individually as vases/mirrors/clocks/candle holders - e.g. 'Pond Mirror L', 'Tempo Wall Clock', 'Ikebana Vase S' all reappear here); 'Garden accessories' (419 products, sampled titles dominated by outdoor cushions, doormats/rugs, watering cans, patio heaters, parasol stands - textiles/garden-tools/hardware); 'Office accessories' (102, staplers/tape dispensers/bookends/magazine racks - functional desk supplies); 'Storage boxes' (general functional storage, not decorative). Excluded per cookware/cutlery/bar-tools rule: Cutlery, Bar accessories, Wine accessories, Knives & knife blocks, Pots & pans, Cutting boards, Bread boxes, Kitchen storage. 'Salt & pepper' (38 items, sampled titles nearly all mills/grinders e.g. 'Alessi100 ES18 Spice Mill', 'Craft Pepper Mill') excluded as functional kitchen tools rather than tableware/decor. 'Jugs & carafes' (127) KEPT under Kitchen & Dining despite its SEO <title> tag reading 'Coffee makers & teapots' - sampled titles are carafes/jugs/teapots/decanters (serveware), matching the Tableware/dinnerware inclusion criteria; category's own breadcrumb/URL name is 'Jugs & carafes'. 'Jewel boxes & cases' (17, under the site's Baskets & storage node) reclassified into Home Decor as 'Decorative Boxes & Cases' - sampled titles are ceramic/wood decorative containers and dishes (e.g. 'Ceramic Containers No.1 Decoration Object', 'La Coupole Tray with Cover', 'Chess Storage Box'), not bulk functional storage. 'Candles' (16 total items) hand-filtered by title per the scented-candle exclusion rule: 8 unscented kept (Column Candle S, Decorative Candle with Face, Dryp Pillar Candle H 20cm, Dryp Set of 2 Stick Candle, Mura Stick Candle Set of 4, Pure Stick Candle Set of 4, Square Taper Candles Set of 4, Stala Candle); 7 explicitly-scented excluded (Fraga Scented Candle L, Olfacte Scented Candle 235g, Scent Elements Fire Candle M, Scented Candle L/M/S, Ura Scented Candle with Lid); 1 non-candle tool excluded (Bzzz Candle Snuffer). 'Outdoor planters' (24, site path /outdoor/flower-boxes, page title 'Buy outdoor planters now') kept as a separate Home Decor leaf alongside indoor Planters since it is a distinct URL/category. All Furniture (incl. Room dividers, Closets, Shelves, Shelving systems, Containers), all Textiles (cushions, rugs, bedding, table linen), High-Tech/Fans, Pet supplies, Fireplaces, Toys and Sale/Brands/Designers/Discover/Classics landing pages excluded as out of scope or NEVER-EXTRACT listing/filter pages.
